name: @klangk/auth-fetch
description: Fetch authenticated web content through the user's browser: opens a sign-in window when the target site needs auth, then delivers the page text to the container

KLANGKWS_FEATURE_AUTH_FETCH_ORIGIN.description: Origin (scheme://host[:port]) of the authenticated site the browser fetches with credentials; added to the frontend CSP connect-src. Set it to the oauth2-proxy/nginx host (e.g. https://thinknix52.tail33f8f4.ts.net:9443) -- without it the browser blocks the cross-origin fetch and the feature reports 'probe unreachable'
